name: Collect and validate data with a spreadsheet
description: Student can collect data and record it in a spreadsheet, checking it is sensible.
exampleOfSuccess: The student enters survey data and checks for impossible entries.
commonError: Student enters data without checking for errors.
checkpointTask: Ask the student to collect a data set in a spreadsheet and check it.

name: Represent data in a suitable display
description: Student can choose and create a suitable display for a data set.
exampleOfSuccess: The student makes a column graph for categorical data with a sensible scale.
commonError: Student chooses a display that does not suit the data type.
checkpointTask: Give a data set. Ask the student to choose and make a suitable display.

name: Find the mode of a data set
description: Student can find the mode of a set of data.
exampleOfSuccess: The student identifies the most frequent value as the mode.
commonError: Student gives the largest value rather than the most frequent.
checkpointTask: Give a data set. Ask the student to find the mode.

name: Describe the shape of a distribution
description: Student can describe the shape of a data distribution in context.
exampleOfSuccess: The student says the data is bunched at the lower end with a few high values.
commonError: Student reads single values without describing the overall shape.
checkpointTask: Show a data display. Ask the student to describe the shape of the distribution.

name: Read a line graph
description: Student can read values from a line graph showing change over time.
exampleOfSuccess: From a temperature graph, the student reads the value at 2 pm.
commonError: Student reads the wrong axis, or misreads between gridlines.
checkpointTask: Show a line graph. Ask the student to read values from it.

name: Interpret a trend in a line graph
description: Student can interpret the trend shown by a line graph.
exampleOfSuccess: The student says the temperature rose through the morning and fell after midday.
commonError: Student describes single points without describing the change.
checkpointTask: Show a line graph. Ask the student to describe the trend.

name: Match a line graph to its context
description: Student can match an unlabelled line graph to the situation it represents.
exampleOfSuccess: The student matches a rising then falling graph to a day's temperature.
commonError: Student matches by shape alone without reasoning about the context.
checkpointTask: Show line graphs and contexts. Ask the student to match each.

name: Draw a conclusion from a line graph
description: Student can draw a conclusion from the relationship shown in a line graph.
exampleOfSuccess: The student concludes the plant grew fastest in the second week.
commonError: Student states values without drawing a conclusion.
checkpointTask: Show a line graph. Ask the student what conclusion can be drawn.

name: Pose a question for an investigation
description: Student can pose a clear, objective question for a statistical investigation.
exampleOfSuccess: The student writes a survey question with clear response options and no bias.
commonError: Student writes a leading or unclear question.
checkpointTask: Ask the student to pose an objective question for an investigation.

name: Collect data for the investigation
description: Student can collect relevant data for their investigation.
exampleOfSuccess: The student gathers responses that match the question.
commonError: Student collects data that does not address the question.
checkpointTask: Have the student collect data for a planned investigation.

name: Choose and create a display
description: Student can choose an appropriate display and create it for the investigation data.
exampleOfSuccess: The student makes a column graph suited to the data.
commonError: Student chooses a display that does not suit the data.
checkpointTask: Ask the student to display their investigation data suitably.

name: Communicate the findings
description: Student can interpret and communicate the findings in the context of the investigation.
exampleOfSuccess: The student reports what the data shows about the original question.
commonError: Student reports numbers without answering the question.
checkpointTask: After the investigation, ask the student what the data shows about the question.
